name: gentoo-overlay-skills
description: Step-by-step skills for gentoo-zh overlay work: bump, new package, review. Policy stays in the overlay's AGENTS.md.

interface.longDescription: Bump, add, and review gentoo-zh packages with pkgdev and pkgcheck. Every rule comes from the overlay's AGENTS.md and .agents/rules; these skills only carry the steps.
defaultPrompt: Bump this gentoo-zh package to the new upstream release.
Add this package to the gentoo-zh overlay.
